scope: Source-assisted learner task; criterion review is not participant performance.

criteria.title: coordinate
criteria.acceptance: Distinguish encoded 0.5 → linear 0.21404114048223255 from linear 0.5 → encoded 0.7353569830524495; state the nonnegative reference domain and absence of measured physical luminance.

criteria.title: mixture-and-quantization
criteria.acceptance: Derive black/white encoded versus linear averages, rounded bytes 128/188 and decoded quantized values 0.21586050011389926/0.5028864580325687. Do not equate finite quantization with the unquantized 0.5.

criteria.title: source-approximation
criteria.acceptance: Compare power 2.2 at 0.5 with the piecewise reference and difference 0.003596500341798453; identify selected material paths and cladding exception, without inferring visual objection or uniform policy.

criteria.title: nonlinear-order
criteria.acceptance: Derive isolated exposure-before-curve 0.6163069544364508 versus curve-then-double 0.7482219061166429 for input 0.25/exposure 2. Preserve omitted composite stages and no full ACES-conformance claim.

criteria.title: verification-scope
criteria.acceptance: All 256 byte round trips support the stated finite calculations, not host-transfer fidelity. Specify source/data/view interpretation and actual import/render/display evidence still needed.

criteria.title: channel-roles
criteria.acceptance: Identify R/G baked normal X/Y, B roughness, A image-derived height proxy, omitted baked Z; neither alpha opacity nor blue normal Z nor physical thickness follows.

criteria.title: data-decoding
criteria.acceptance: Decode authored 128,128,128,64 as normalized data and signed RG 0.0039215686274509665, compare wrong sRGB-first RG-0.5682789997722015; alpha 0.25098039215686274 is not transparency under this contract.

criteria.title: consumer-use
criteria.acceptance: Locate named shader RG/B reads and absence of alpha displacement/Z reconstruction there. Derive concrete no-rain roughness 0.850392156862745 versus incorrect 0.7931721000227798; no complete rendered-output claim.

criteria.title: metadata-disagreement
criteria.acceptance: Both existing 512 x 512 RGBA 8 PNGs contain color chunks; preserve packed NRH sRGB/gAMA/cHRM versus declared Non-Color. Do not invent fresh bake or exact generation history, whole-repo defect or actual importer interpretation.

criteria.title: target-check
criteria.acceptance: Propose known-texel destination checks under explicit color/data/channel/remapping policy; Godot 4.6 source_color guidance is renderer-specific, and a standard full normal contract does not match packed blue roughness. No actual host import delivered.

criteria.title: digital-region
criteria.acceptance: Verify each 160 x 160 target has 25600 RGB 128 pixels under recorded half-open bounds and matching crop hashes; unequal surrounds remain distinct, no display-luminance or observer result inferred.

criteria.title: task-and-appearance
criteria.acceptance: Separate byte equality, perceived light intensity/brightness and perceived reflectance/lightness. Cite primary study at its actual scope; original two-surround control is not a replication and has no prescribed observer answer.

criteria.title: display-boundary
criteria.acceptance: Our PNG carries sRGB intent 0 while inspected capture writer emits no color-space chunk; neither alone calibrates a display or proves a visual match/browser behavior.

criteria.title: procedure
criteria.acceptance: Use neutral wording, counterbalance surround side and allow equal/unsure; only first layout rendered, no swapped layout/participants/responses. No population effect or magnitude invented.

criteria.title: handoff
criteria.acceptance: Report digital hash/crop equality, declared encoding, observed display settings and actual observer result separately. Missing outcomes remain missing; no normative schema or craft-quality equivalence is established.

pass_policy: All five criteria per module; record actual answers, assistance, reviewer, evidence and individual decisions. Preserve failures and unresolved observations.
